Title: [LSJo] Does control of Regent change when it is moved via diablerie?

Messages.Author: Unique Master
Messages.Body:
LSJo, (a real american hero)

Does control of Regent change when it is moved via diablerie?

For example:
Last night my second VP was stolen via a beautifully played Life Boon. With
2 pool and a cratered spirit, I was ready to die on my predator's turn. My
Grandprey's Cailean, with my permission, diablerizes my Tarbaby Jack,
Regent. When I am ousted, does Regent burn?

Regent:

Unique

Put this card on a Sabbat vampire you control with a capacity above 7. This
vampire has the title of Cardinal and has one addition vote as well. Burn
this card if this vampire receives another title. Any Sabbat vampire with a
different controller can enter combat with this vampire as a (D) action. If
a Sabbat vampire diablerizes this vampire, move this card to the diablerist
(before the blood hunt is called).

There was confusion as the card does not specify whether control changes.

Knowing is half the battle,

Mike Ooi
